player_prompt.intro:
Kai ne Ɗan {player_id} ke takaɓa wasan Pig Dice.

Ka'idoji:
- A kullunka, za ka iya '[roll]' ko '[hold]'
- Kunnawa 2-6: Ɓara zuwa jimlar kullun
- Kunnawa 1: Rasa jimlar kullun kuma ƙare kullun
- Kulle: Ɓara jimlar kullun zuwa maki na ku kuma ƙare kullun
- Na farko zuwa {winning_score} maki ya ci nasara

A lokacin da kullun ya zuwa, za ka ga jimlar ci gaba na kullun.
Amsa da '[roll]' don kunnawa die ko '[hold]' don banki maki na ku.
